schema_invalid.description: JSON shape or field validation failed.

capability_missing.description: No Task-scoped mailbox or control credential was supplied.

capability_invalid.description: The handle is unknown, malformed, or inconsistent with its profile.

capability_rotated.description: A newer capability rotation generation exists.

capability_scope_mismatch.description: The handle does not bind this workspace, Task, channel, or epoch.

action_not_allowed.description: The action is outside the profile-derived action set.

panel_turn_forbidden_in_source_hosted.description: A panel model Turn was requested while the Task is source_hosted.

channel_mismatch.description: The handle and Task channels differ.

workspace_mismatch.description: The handle does not bind the Task workspace.

thread_binding_missing.description: The current environment Thread id is missing.

thread_binding_mismatch.description: The source Session and environment Thread ids differ.

thread_rebinding_forbidden.description: The source-hosted Task is already bound to another environment Thread.

attachment_source_identity_invalid.description: The source attachment identity is malformed.

attachment_source_identity_conflict.description: The source attachment identity is already bound to different content.

recovery_unavailable.description: The current Task does not support source-hosted recovery.

recovery_not_required.description: The current source-hosted Task is not in a recoverable error state.

thread_binding_invalid.description: A source-hosted Thread reference is not a UUID.

idempotency_conflict.description: The idempotency key was reused with a different canonical payload.

revision_conflict.description: The expected Task revision is stale.

lease_conflict.description: The expected execution owner or epoch is not current.

stale_owner.description: The execution result belongs to a previous execution epoch.

checkpoint_required.description: The ownership transition lacks a valid checkpoint.

checkpoint_incomplete.description: Required source or panel acknowledgement coverage is incomplete.

confirmation_invalid.description: The confirmation is unknown or bound to another Task or mode.

confirmation_consumed.description: The confirmation was already used by a different logical transition.

snapshot_required.description: A new coherent snapshot baseline is required.

snapshot_capacity_exceeded.description: Bounded active snapshot metadata is exhausted.

resync_required.description: Cursor or generation continuity is invalid.

ack_not_allowed.description: The event is not targeted to the current actor role.

ack_not_delivered.description: The event has not been delivered through pull.

payload_too_large.description: The event batch or payload exceeds the limit.

rate_limited.description: The local request budget is exhausted.
